name: rps-keypoint-classifier
title: 猜拳关键点分类器
input: 21 hand landmarks detected by MediaPipe Hand Landmarker

privacy.reportedData: labels, confidence, keypoint quality, completion status, and user-confirmed sample attachments

training.nextStep: Export confirmed classroom samples, extract hand landmarks, train a lightweight classifier, and replace rps-classifier.json.

notes: This bootstrap classifier is designed to make the courseware usable while collecting real samples. Version 0.1.1 improves fist/rock tolerance for curled-finger landmark noise. It should be replaced by a trained model before broad production rollout.
